root_idea.summary: The root is oriented around beginning and precedence on one side, and return to an endpoint, state, or outcome on the other.
root_idea.development: From the ideas of what comes first and what a thing returns to, the lexical branches extend to restoration, reduction, result, interpretation, governance, and relation to a person or group. A separate animal name is explained through the animal's resort to the mountain.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the noun آل, meaning the family, household, or associated people of a named person.
Displayed under the normalized citation form أَوَّل.
Displayed under the citation form أُولُو, with أُولِي as its oblique form; the supplied lexical evidence identifies the case forms but does not supply a direct semantic definition.
Displayed as the verbal noun تَأْوِيل.
The two occurrences are the same lexical item أَوَّل in an adverbial or otherwise differently tagged use, not a separate dictionary headword.

senses.definition: The family, household, people, or followers associated with a named person.
senses.usage_conditions: Used chiefly in construction with the name of a prominent or noble person; the association may be by kinship, household, religion, allegiance, or following, and is not limited to blood relatives.

senses.definition: First, preceding, foremost, or belonging to an earlier time or group.
senses.usage_conditions: The same lexical sense is used for priority in sequence or time and for former or earlier people, events, or states; gender, number, case, and adverbial tagging do not create separate senses.

senses.definition: Interpretation or explanation that discloses the meaning to which an expression is reduced, especially a non-obvious or equivocal meaning.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes explaining language and rendering an equivocal or ambiguous Quranic expression according to a meaning it bears beyond its immediately apparent wording.

senses.definition: The interpretation of a dream, including the account of what it signifies or leads to.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional use for explaining a dream and its eventual sequel; it is a specialized application of interpretation, not merely a grammatical paraphrase.

senses.definition: The ultimate result, end, fulfillment, or eventual state to which a matter comes.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of the final outcome of a statement, command, dispute, promise, threat, or event, including its realization or manifestation in the end.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return, revert, or come back to an origin, source, place, former state, or prior condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be used of a person, thing, action, saying, quantity, or condition; also with إِلَى for returning to or coming to something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trace back or bear a relation to someone through kinship, religion, or an associated origin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational construction developed from the idea of returning or referring back to an origin or group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To result in destruction of life, killing, or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic resultative construction in which a blow or stroke comes to the consequence of destroying life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come ultimately to a specified state, condition, or result.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair or case reaching its eventual condition; this is a Classical resultative use of the verb, distinct from the Quranic noun تَأْوِيل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become reduced, diminished, deficient, or lean.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a cooked liquid or other substance becoming reduced in quantity, and of a body or animal losing flesh; the particular object is illustrative rather than restrictive.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proleptic or anticipative trope, applying a designation before the condition it ordinarily denotes has fully occurred.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical expression based on naming something in anticipation of its later state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thicken, coagulate, or reach a dense and fully matured consistency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of milk, tar, honey, oil, wine or drink, urine, and similar substances; it may be intransitive or, in a reported transitive use, mean to make such a substance thicken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw oneself together or contract the body, especially by hunching or shrugging the shoulders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical idiom describing bodily contraction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To escape from someone or become safe or secure from him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a dialectal variant of وَأَلَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rule, govern, or preside over subjects, managing their affairs well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a prince, king, commander, or governor and his people or subjects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manage, tend, compose, or put property or an affair into a good and proper condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of managing cattle, camels, or other property so that they prosper, and of composing or putting an unsettled matter in order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manage camels in husbandry, including driving them or binding their udders until milking time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-management construction with variant explanations in the lexical sources.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To restore, return, or bring a person or thing back to someone or to a specified state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The causative Form II construction may also mean to cause something to come to a condition or reduce it to that condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In grammatical analysis, to render a word, expression, or phrase by another equivalent expression.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical construction, distinct from the Quranic noun تَأْوِيل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discover or seek good, goodness, or recompense in a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V use involving inference from outward signs or seeking a hoped-for return from someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek the interpretation of a dream through consideration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X construction specifically reported for seeking to understand a dream.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's visible body, figure, or person, especially as seen from a distance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metaphorical extension of آل meaning a person's household or members; the sense is applied to the whole person or corporeal form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A raised, conspicuous projection or extremity, such as the higher parts of a camel or the sides and extremities of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported extension to elevated or prominent material parts; the examples concern camels and mountains but do not restrict the sense to either.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the related use for the tent's structural poles or timbers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The poles, timbers, or structural pieces of a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the wooden pieces on which a tent is raised or constructed, including pieces with the tent cloth removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mirage or mirage-like appearance that raises and makes distant figures seem to quiver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical descriptions distinguish it from سراب by time of day or by whether the apparent figures are raised above the ground, though authorities differ on the distinction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument, tool, implement, or apparatus used for working; by specialization, a musical instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may be singular or collective in usage and has a regular plural آَلَات.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The male organ of generation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bier used to carry a corpse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use, with variant interpretation reported for the cited poetic example.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or condition, especially a difficult, straitened, or distressing condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The broader sense means a condition generally; straitness or distress is a further Classical specialization.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The relations to whom a person is traced back in genealogy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal term for genealogical relations or ancestral connection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's natural disposition, original state, or customary condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with رَدَدْتُهُ إِلَى to mean returning someone to that disposition or state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a particular idol associated with the tribes of Bakr and Taghlib.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper name, not a general lexical meaning of precedence or return.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vessel or receptacle in which milk, drink, or expressed juice is allowed to thicken or mature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of the container for thickening milk or beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rule, government, or political administration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting governance or government, whether treated as an infinitive noun or a simple noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wild mountain goat, especially the male ibex.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained as referring to an animal that resorts to or takes refuge in the mountains; variant vocalizations and forms occur.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thickening or thick, especially of milk, urine, oil, tar, honey, or drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial adjective; variant reports also associate related forms with thickened or changed milk and goat milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a reported variant, the thickened residue of milk or seminal fluid in the womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word-form assignment and precise referent are disputed within the cited lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good manager or tender of cattle, camels, or similar property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active-participial expression for one who manages livestock well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A return, course, destination, or eventual state to which a person or thing comes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the ultimate place, condition, or outcome of a process or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A refuge or place of recourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied in this sense to God as the ultimate refuge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ruler or governor possessing authority to judge, decide, or pass sentence over a people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized participial or descriptive expression for political and judicial authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good discovery or inference drawn from outward signs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an interpretation or discovery judged good in the context of seeking signs of goodness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Veracious or truthful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare reported use opposed to مُتَقَوِّل, one who fabricates or says something falsely.

cautions: The supplied evidence identifies أُولُو and its oblique form أُولِي only through a grammatical pointer; the defining lexical article is not included, so no direct Quranic sense is asserted for that public form.

Some variant word-form assignments and meanings in the discussion of آئِل and أُيَّل are explicitly disputed; those rare senses are retained with that limitation rather than treated as settled meanings.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The Quranic أُولُو/أُولِي group has 45 occurrences and contextual glosses such as “possessors” and “those endowed,” but the supplied Lane unit only gives its nominative and oblique case forms and points to an absent article. Its direct lexical definition cannot therefore be established from this packet without relying on contextual English alone.

In lane:entry:7512, the references to thickened milk, remains, seminal fluid, and the related vessel do not always identify the exact headword or form. The retained classical entries mark the reported variant and uncertainty.
